overview: Built and coded an AI-powered skincare platform and Telegram catalog bot for Medaf Skin Care that simplifies routine discovery for beauty customers. Taking end-to-end full-stack engineering ownership, I coded the solution with Next.js, Nest.js, and PostgreSQL—implementing AI diagnostic recommendation algorithms, an automated Telegram bot for browsing product catalogs and ordering, and a modern responsive storefront.

productArchitecture.overview: The Medaf Skincare product architecture connects three core touchpoints into a unified customer and management flow:

challenge: Customers routinely experienced product choice paralysis and hesitation when purchasing skincare online due to uncertain compatibility with their unique skin conditions and types.
solution: Coded the complete system end-to-end: (1) Developed the AI diagnostic recommendation engine that analyzes skin parameters to suggest tailored regimens; (2) Programmed an event-driven Telegram Bot webhook in Nest.js enabling conversational catalog browsing, product filtering, and instant checkout; (3) Built a responsive Next.js storefront; and (4) Integrated an automated delivery system with interactive map selection, external location provider integration, and real-time delivery cost calculation on checkout, backed by structured relational PostgreSQL tables for products, inventory, customer quizzes, and orders.

architecture.problem: Customers experienced high decision friction identifying products tailored to specific skin types, reducing checkout completion rates.
architecture.tradeoffs: Coded a modular Nest.js microservice backend coupled with Next.js and PostgreSQL, orchestrating AI rule-based recommendation pipelines and real-time Telegram Bot webhook event loops over disjointed manual order handling.
